subject: Theory Wellness Dispensary and Arts Center Review
overview: The board reviewed site plans for a seven-unit residential project on Broadway and a marijuana dispensary combined with a community arts center on Mystic Avenue. Both projects were referred to the Zoning Board of Appeals with favorable recommendations and specific design conditions.

items.title: 595 Broadway Site Plan Review
items.summary: Recommended approval to the Zoning Board of Appeals for a seven-unit residential building, re-evaluating a previously approved 2020 proposal. Conditions include exploring a second egress stoop for fire safety, installing electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and a recommendation to reduce the parking count to align with updated zoning standards.

items.title: 162 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Recommended approval for a Theory Wellness retail marijuana dispensary and a Medford Arts Collaborative center within a repurposed former dealership. Conditions include traffic mitigation measures such as radar feedback signs, the addition of exterior murals and increased landscaping, and compliance with solar and linkage fee ordinances.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the July 14, 2022 meeting minutes with minor formatting updates and discussed the public availability of the draft Comprehensive Plan.
